jcr:content.jcr:title: Infants on international flights

master.answer:
• Infants must have their own ticket for international flights – but this does not include a seat.
  • All infants booked online must travel either in the lap of the adult travelling with them, or if you booked a bassinet, be placed in the bassinet when permitted during the flight.
  • Infants under two years old who don’t occupy a separate seat are charged 10% of the adult fare when accompanied by an adult. There must be one adult for every infant booked, or a fare must be paid.
  • If your infant under two years old will occupy their own seat, you will need to book a seat for them and provide their age. A discount may apply depending on the route.
  • If your booking includes flights operated by other airlines, check directly with those airlines for their policies on infants occupying a seat.
